# ECN-2026-024 - Change notice - Heat Treat hydraulic forging press #2

Revision: Rev A  
Plant: P1, line P1-L4  
Equipment: EQ-P1-L4-HP02

Reason for change
- Recent inspection discovered inconsistent preload on the main ram bolt of EQ-P1-L4-HP02 affecting ram alignment and bearing load distribution. Field verification requires a defined and documented torque requirement to restore and maintain correct preload. This ECN establishes the approved main ram bolt torque and updates maintenance references to ensure consistent application.

Affected items
- Heat Treat hydraulic forging press #2 (EQ-P1-L4-HP02) main ram bolt assembly and associated maintenance procedures.  
- Maintenance work instructions and asset records that reference torque values for EQ-P1-L4-HP02.  
- Related documents: MM-P1-L4-HP02-S2, SOP-P1-L4-01, SOP-P1-L4-05

Implementation
- Set and record the main ram bolt torque for EQ-P1-L4-HP02 to 970 N·m. Use calibrated torque equipment and the process steps contained in SOP-P1-L4-01 and SOP-P1-L4-05 to perform the operation. Reference MM-P1-L4-HP02-S2 for asset-specific access and isolation instructions prior to torque application.  
- Update MM-P1-L4-HP02-S2 to include the 970 N·m torque value in the bolt specification table and the verification checklist. Update SOP-P1-L4-01 and SOP-P1-L4-05 to reference the revised torque value where applicable.  
- Record actions in the maintenance log for EQ-P1-L4-HP02 and include the calibrated tool serial number, operator initials, and reference to this ECN.

Approvals
- Engineering: approval required to confirm torque value selection and documentation updates.  
- Operations: approval required to schedule and accept machine return to service following implementation.  
- Maintenance: approval required to perform the work and confirm updates to MM-P1-L4-HP02-S2 and SOP-P1-L4-01 / SOP-P1-L4-05.

Related documents
- MM-P1-L4-HP02-S2  
- SOP-P1-L4-01  
- SOP-P1-L4-05
